H2600.def: from «02580»; gratis, i.e. devoid of cost, reason or advantage:--without a cause (cost, wages), causeless, to cost nothing, free(-ly), innocent, for nothing (nought, in vain.

H2601.def: probably by orthographical variation for «02606»; Chanamel, an Israelite:--Hanameel.

H2602.def: of uncertain derivation; perhaps the aphis or plantlouse:--frost.

H2603.def: a primitive root (compare «02583»); properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition):--beseech, × fair, (be, find, shew) favour(-able), be (deal, give, grant (gracious(-ly), intreat, (be) merciful, have (shew) mercy (on, upon), have pity upon, pray, make supplication, × very.

H2604.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «02603»; to favor or (causatively) to entreat:--shew mercy, make supplication.

H2605.def: from «02603»; favor; Chanan, the name of seven Israelites:--Canan.

H2606.def: from «02603» and «0410»; God has favored; Chananel, probably an Israelite, from whom a tower of Jerusalem was named:--Hananeel.

H2607.def: from «02603»; gracious; Chanani, the name of six Israelites:--Hanani.

H2608.def: or Chananyahuw {khan-an-yaw'-hoo}; from «02603» and «03050»; Jah has favored; Chananjah, the name of thirteen Israelites:--Hananiah.

H2609.def: of Egyptian derivation; Chanes, a place in Egypt:--Hanes.

H2610.def: a primitive root; to soil, especially in a moral sense:--corrupt, defile, × greatly, pollute, profane.

H2611.def: from «02610»; soiled (i.e. with sin), impious:-- hypocrite(-ical).

H2614.def: a primitive root (compare «02596»); to be narrow; by implication, to throttle, or (reflex.) to choke oneself to death (by a rope):--hang self, strangle.

H2615.def: probably from «02603»; favored; Channathon, a place in Palestine:--Hannathon.

H2616.def: a primitive root; properly, perhaps to bow (the neck only (compare «02603») in courtesy to an equal), i.e. to be kind; also (by euphem. (compare «0l288»), but rarely) to reprove:--shew self merciful, put to shame.

H2617.def: from «02616»; kindness; by implication (towards God) piety: rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty:--favour, good deed(-liness, -ness), kindly, (loving-)kindness, merciful (kindness), mercy, pity, reproach, wicked thing.

H2618.def: the same as «02617»: favor; Chesed, an Israelite:--Hesed.

H2619.def: from «02617» and «03050»; Jah has favored: Chasadjah, an Israelite:--Hasadiah.

H2620.def: a primitive root; to flee for protection (compare «0982»); figuratively, to confide in:--have hope, make refuge, (put) trust.

H2621.def: from «02620»; hopeful; Chosah, an Israelite; also a place in Palestine:--Hosah.

H2623.def: from «02616»; properly, kind, i.e. (religiously) pious (a saint):--godly (man), good, holy (one), merciful, saint, (un- )godly.

H2624.def: feminine of «02623»; the kind (maternal) bird, i.e. a stork:--X feather, stork.

H2625.def: from «02628»; the ravager, i.e. a locust:--caterpillar.

H2626.def: from «02630»; properly, firm, i.e. (by implication) mighty:--strong.

H2627.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «02637»; deficient:--wanting.

H2628.def: a primitive root; to eat off:--consume.

H2629.def: a primitive root; to muzzle; by analogy, to stop the nose:--muzzle, stop.

H2630.def: a primitive root; properly, to (be) compact; by implication, to hoard:--lay up.

H2631.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «02630»; to hold in occupancy:--possess.

H2635.et: from a root corresponding to that of (02636)
H2635.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of «02636»; a clod:--clay.

H2636.et: reduplicated from an unused root meaning apparently to peel
H2636.def: reduplicated from an unused root meaning apparently to peel; a shred or scale:--round thing.

H2637.def: a primitive root; to lack; by implication, to fail, want, lessen:--be abated, bereave, decrease, (cause to) fail, (have) lack, make lower, want.

H2638.def: from «02637»; lacking; hence, without:--destitute, fail, lack, have need, void, want.

H2643.et: from (02653) (in the moral sense of covered from soil)
H2643.def: from «02653» (in the moral sense of covered from soil); pure:--innocent.

H2644.def: an orthographical variation of «02645»; properly, to cover, i.e. (in a sinister sense) to act covertly:--do secretly.

H2645.def: a primitive root (compare «02644», «02653»); to cover; by implication, to veil, to encase, protect:--ceil, cover, overlay.

H2647.def: the same as «02646»; Chuppah, an Israelite:--Huppah.

H2648.def: a primitive root; properly, to start up suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, to fear:--(make) haste (away), tremble.

H2651.et: from an unused root of uncertain signification
H2651.def: from an unused root of uncertain signification; a fist (only in the dual):--fists, (both) hands, hand(-ful).

H2652.def: from «02651»; perhaps pugilist; Chophni, an Israelite:--Hophni.

H2653.def: a primitive root (compare «02645», «03182»); to cover (in protection):--cover.

H2654.def: a primitive root; properly, to incline to; by implication (literally but rarely) to bend; figuratively, to be pleased with, desire:--X any at all, (have, take) delight, desire, favour, like, move, be (well) pleased, have pleasure, will, would.

H2655.def: from «02654»; pleased with:--delight in, desire, favour, please, have pleasure, whosoever would, willing, wish.

H2656.def: from «02654»; pleasure; hence (abstractly) desire; concretely, a valuable thing; hence (by extension) a matter (as something in mind):--acceptable, delight(-some), desire, things desired, matter, pleasant(-ure), purpose, willingly.

H2657.def: from «02656» with suffixes; my delight (is) in her; Cheptsi-bah, a fanciful name for Palestine:--Hephzi-bah.

H2658.def: a primitive root; properly, to pry into; by implication, to delve, to explore:--dig, paw, search out, seek.

H2659.et: a primitive root [perhaps rath, the same as (02658) through the idea of detection]
H2659.def: a primitive root (perhaps rath. the same as «02658» through the idea of detection): to blush; figuratively, to be ashamed, disappointed; causatively, to shame, reproach:--be ashamed, be confounded, be brought to confusion (unto shame), come (be put to) shame, bring reproach.

H2660.def: from «02658» or «02659»; a pit of shame; Chepher, a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites:--Hepher.

H2661.def: from «02658»; a hole; only in connection with «06512», which ought rather to be joined as one word, thus chapharperah {khaf-ar- pay-raw'}; by reduplication from «02658»; a burrower, i.e. probably a rat:--+ mole.

H2662.def: patronymically from «02660»; a Chephrite (collectively) or descendants of Chepher:--Hepherites.

H2663.def: dual of «02660»; double pit; Chapharajim, a place in Palestine:--Haphraim.

H2664.def: a primitive root; to seek; causatively, to conceal oneself (i.e. let be sought), or mask:--change, (make) diligent (search), disquise self, hide, search (for, out).

H2665.def: from «02664»; something covert, i.e. a trick:--search.

H2666.def: a primitive root; to spread loose; figuratively, to manumit:--be free.

H2667.def: from «02666»; something spread loosely, i.e. a carpet:--precious.

H2669.def: and chophshiyth {khof-sheeth'}; from «02666»; prostration by sickness (with «01004», a hospital):--several.

H2670.def: from «02666»; exempt (from bondage, tax or care):--free, liberty.

H2671.def: from «02686»; properly, a piercer, i.e. an arrow; by implication, a wound; figuratively, (of God) thunder-bolt; (by interchange for «06086») the shaft of a spear:--+ archer, arrow, dart, shaft, staff, wound.

H2672.def: or chatseb {khaw-tsabe'}; a primitive root ; to cut or carve (wood), stone or other material); by implication, to hew, split, square, quarry, engrave:--cut, dig, divide, grave, hew (out, -er), made, mason.

H2673.def: a primitive root (compare «02086»)); to cut or split in two; to halve:--divide, × live out half, reach to the midst, participle

H2674.def: a collective form of «02691»; village; Chatsor, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine and of one in Arabia:-- Hazor.

H2675.et: from (02674) and a Aramaic form of the fem. of (02319) [compare (02323)]
H2675.def: from «02674» and a Aramaizing form of the feminine of 2319 (compare «02323»); new Chatsor, a place in Palestine:--Hazor, Hadattah (as if two places).

H2677.def: from «02673»; the half or middle:--half, middle, mid(-night), midst, part, two parts.

H2678.def: or chetsiy {chay-tsee'}; prolongation from «02671»; an arrow:--arrow.

H2679.et: from (02677) and the plural of (04496), with the article interposed
H2679.def: from «02677» and the plural of «04496», with the article interposed; midst of the resting- places; Chatsi-ham-Menuchoth, an Israelite:--half of the Manahethites.

H2680.def: patronymically from «02679»; a Chatsi-ham-Menachtite or descendant of Chatsi-ham-Menuchoth:--half of the Manahethites.

H2681.def: a collateral form of «02691»; a court or abode:--court.

H2682.et: perhaps originally the same as (02681), from the greenness of a courtyard
H2682.def: perhaps originally the same as «02681», from the greenness of a courtyard; grass; also a leek (collectively):--grass, hay, herb, leek.

H2683.et: from an unused root meaning to hold firmly
H2683.def: from an unused root meaning to hold firmly; the bosom (as comprised between the arms):--bosom.

H2684.et: a collateral form of (02683), and meaning the same
H2684.def: a collateral form of «02683», and meaning the same:--arm, lap.

H2685.def: (Aramaic) a primitive root; properly, to shear or cut close; figuratively, to be severe:--hasty, be urgent.

H2686.def: a primitive root (compare «02673»); properly, to chop into, pierce or sever; hence, to curtail, to distribute (into ranks); as denom. from «02671», to shoot an arrow:--archer, × bands, cut off in the midst.

H2687.def: from «02687»; properly, something cutting; hence, gravel (as grit); also (like «02671») an arrow:--arrow, gravel (stone).

H2688.def: or Chatsatson Tamar {khats-ats-one' taw-mawr'}; from «02686» and «08558»; division (i.e. perhaps row) of (the) palm-tree; Chatsetson-tamar, a place in Palestine:--Hazezon- tamar.

H2689.def: by reduplication from «02690»; a trumpet (from its sundered or quavering note):--trumpet(-er).

H2690.def: a primitive root; properly, to surround with a stockade, and thus separate from the open country; but used only in the reduplicated form chatsotser {khast-o-tsare'}; or (2 Chronicles 5:12) chatsorer {khats-o-rare'}; as dem. from «02689»; to trumpet, i.e. blow on that instrument:--blow, sound, trumpeter.

H2691.def: (masculine and feminine); from «02690» in its original sense; a yard (as inclosed by a fence); also a hamlet (as similarly surrounded with walls):--court, tower, village.

H2692.def: from «02691» and «0146»; (the) village of Addar; Chatsar-Addar, a place in Palestine:--Hazar-addar.

H2693.def: from «02691» and a feminine of «01408»; (the) village of (female) Fortune; Chatsar-Gaddah, a place in Palestine:--Hazar-gaddah.

H2694.et: from (02691) and (08484) with the article interposed
H2694.def: from «02691» and «08484» with the article interposed; village of the middle; Chatsar-hat-Tikon, a place in Palestine:--Hazar-hatticon.

H2695.def: by an orthographical variation for «02696»; enclosure; Chetsro, an Israelite:--Hezro, Hezrai.

H2696.def: from «02691»; court-yard; Chetsron, the name of a place in Palestine; also of two Israelites:--Hezron.

H2697.def: patronymically from «02696»; a Chetsronite or (collectively) descendants of Chetsron:--Hezronites.

H2698.def: feminine plural of «02691»; yards; Chatseroth, a place in Palestine:--Hazeroth.

H2699.def: plural masculine of «02691»; yards; Chatserim, a place in Palestine:--Hazerim.
